iWantTo: see all locations where a SKU is stocked, including the tracking code for each location
soThat: I can drill into a specific SKU and see its complete distribution across the warehouse

independence.rationale: Story 2 shows aggregate stock across all SKUs in a home table. Story 3 shows a detail view for a single SKU across its locations with tracking codes. The observable outcomes are distinct: home table (many SKUs at once) vs detail page (one SKU, deeper attributes). Building S1 and S2 fully does not deliver the SKU detail page view and tracking code display that S3 adds.
